description: Replay cases.jsonl against the built Rust module and list mismatches. With `profile: "android"`, replay on the device against the .so built for its ABI.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

device.description: Android device serial; picked automatically when only one is connected.

float_tolerance.description: Floats match within this tolerance for this run (the one saved by record otherwise).

ignore_key_order.description: Compare objects regardless of key order.

jni_libs.description: Android libraries folder to diff; defaults to <crate>/jniLibs.

module.description: Test this JS module instead of the crate's `index.cjs`.

profile.description: Diff on this machine (default) or on a connected Android device (JVM crates).

name: diff
title: Diff port against recording
